"""AP5 offline derivative; canonical runtime remains untouched."""
import argparse
import hashlib
import json
from pathlib import Path

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]
parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
parser.add_argument("destination", type=Path)
args = parser.parse_args()
source = ROOT / "src/cuda/norm/reference.cu"
moe = ROOT / "src/cuda/moe/reference.cu"
text = source.read_text()
begin = text.index("template <typename Input>\n__global__ void RmsNormResidualBf16Kernel(")
end = text.index("__global__ void RmsNormResidualPhysicalBf16Kernel(", begin)
original = text[begin:end]
moe_text = moe.read_text()
tree = moe_text[moe_text.index("__device__ float MoeBlockSum(float value) {"):]
tree = tree[:tree.index("__device__ float MoeDualGroupSum(")]
tree = (tree.replace("MoeBlockSum", "Ap5BlockSum")
        .replace("kNormThreads", "kThreads").replace("kWarpSize", "32U"))
candidate = (original.replace("RmsNormResidualBf16Kernel", "Ap5AttentionPostnormKernel")
             .replace("BlockSum(squared_sum)", "Ap5BlockSum(squared_sum)"))
assert candidate != original and candidate.count("Ap5BlockSum(") == 1
text = text[:end] + tree + candidate + text[end:]
text += r'''
#define AP5_ARGS const float* input,const std::uint16_t* weight,const float* residual,float* normalized,float* output,unsigned rows,float epsilon,const std::uint16_t* scalar,cudaStream_t stream
#define AP5_VALUES input,weight,residual,normalized,output,2816U,epsilon,scalar
extern "C" cudaError_t ap5_parent(AP5_ARGS) {
  using namespace gem16::internal;
  RmsNormResidualBf16Kernel<float><<<rows,256,0,stream>>>(AP5_VALUES);
  return cudaGetLastError();
}
extern "C" cudaError_t ap5_candidate(AP5_ARGS) {
  using namespace gem16::internal;
  Ap5AttentionPostnormKernel<float><<<rows,256,0,stream>>>(AP5_VALUES);
  return cudaGetLastError();
}
'''
with args.destination.open("x") as f:
    f.write(text)
with args.destination.with_suffix(".provenance.json").open("x") as f:
    json.dump({"source_sha256": hashlib.sha256(source.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),
               "accepted_moe_source_sha256": hashlib.sha256(moe.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),
               "generator_sha256": hashlib.sha256(Path(__file__).read_bytes()).hexdigest(),
               "generated_sha256": hashlib.sha256(text.encode()).hexdigest(),
               "transform": "duplicate float residual norm only; exact accepted MoE binary tree CTA128/64/32, warp0 16/8/4/2/1 syncwarp after each, final CTA; no generic dispatch change",
               "candidate_kernel": candidate, "replacement_reduction": tree}, f, indent=2)

from pathlib import Path
import sys,json,shutil,statistics,math,random
OUT=Path(__file__).resolve().parent;ROOT=OUT.parents[4];sys.path.insert(0,str(OUT.with_name('ap1-measurement')));import run as r
r.OUT=OUT
source=ROOT/'tests/cuda/attention_postnorm_warp_screen.cu';shutil.copyfile(source,OUT/'screen-source.cu')
r.run('offline-screen-build',['/opt/cuda/bin/nvcc','-std=c++20','-O3','-DNDEBUG','-arch=sm_120a','-rdc=true','--expt-relaxed-constexpr','-I'+str(ROOT/'include'),'-I'+str(ROOT/'src'),str(source),str(OUT/'postnorm-v2.generated.cu'),'-o',str(OUT/'postnorm-screen')],120)
for label,mode in [('actual-screen','screen'),('boundary-screen','boundaries')]:
 r.idle_and_cool();r.run(label,[str(OUT/'postnorm-screen'),str(OUT/'actual-cases-v2.tsv'),mode,str(OUT/(label+'.json'))],120)
data=r.load(OUT/'actual-screen.json');assert len(data['cases'])==8
res=data['resources'];assert res['parent_local_bytes']==res['candidate_local_bytes']==0
cases=[]
for case in data['cases']:
 assert case['consumed_outputs_bit_exact']
 cases.append({**case,'gain':statistics.median(case['parent_us'])/statistics.median(case['candidate_us'])-1})
rng=random.Random(2026110405);samples=[]
for _ in range(10000):samples.append(math.exp(statistics.mean(math.log(statistics.median(rng.choices(c['parent_us'],k=10))/statistics.median(rng.choices(c['candidate_us'],k=10))) for c in cases))-1)
samples.sort();passed=all(c['gain']>0 for c in cases) and samples[250]>0
with (OUT/'operator-summary.json').open('x') as f:json.dump({'cases':cases,'resources':res,'all_actual_consumed_bits_exact':True,'all_case_medians_positive':all(c['gain']>0 for c in cases),'geomean_gain':math.exp(statistics.mean(math.log(1+c['gain']) for c in cases))-1,'bootstrap95':[samples[250],samples[9749]],'timing_gate_passed':passed,'scope':'8realR1/R3postnormcases;actualnormalized-pointerpresence;128launchcachewarmgraphs;3warm10alternating;notprimarythroughput'},f,indent=2)
print('AP5 OFFLINE TIMING GATE',passed,'gains',[c['gain'] for c in cases],flush=True)
for tool in ['memcheck','synccheck']:
 label='boundary-'+tool
 r.run(label,['compute-sanitizer','--tool',tool,'--error-exitcode','99','--log-file',str(OUT/(label+'.sanitizer.log')),str(OUT/'postnorm-screen'),str(OUT/'actual-cases-v2.tsv'),'boundaries',str(OUT/(label+'.json'))],120)
 assert 'ERROR SUMMARY: 0 errors' in (OUT/(label+'.sanitizer.log')).read_text()
print('AP5 OFFLINE ACTUAL/BOUNDARY/SANITIZERS DONE; no production promotion',flush=True)
